text.en:
The following sums in Mexican money are hereby appropriated out of any money in the Insular
Treasury, not otherwise appropriated, to pay expenses incurred and salaries earned, not provided for in the
General Appropriation Act for the first quarter of the year nineteen hundred and one, for the purposes and
objects hereinafter specified:
For the district commander of Pollok, Mindanao, for salaries and wages, five hundred and fifty-
one dollars; for rents and repairs, one hundred and twenty dollars; for subsistence for prisoners,
convicts, and destitute citizens, ninety dollars; for medicines and for miscellaneous expenses,
two hundred and twenty-eight dollars; for salary of school teacher and interpreter and for
miscellaneous expenses for December, nineteen hundred, eighty dollars.
Total for the district commander at Pollok, Mindanao, one thousand and sixty-nine dollars.
For the medical supply depot at Cavite:
For the purchase of medical supplies for indigent sick natives at Olongapo, Subig, Pollok and
Port Isabela, six hundred dollars.
For the medical supply depot, department of the Visayas, for maintenance of vaccine farm,
seven hundred and forty-eight dollars; for salaries of natives, ninety dollars; for purchase of
medicines, five thousand dollars.
Total for the medical supply depot, Department of the Visayas, five thousand, eight hundred
and thirty-eight dollars.

For the inspector of customs at Tacloban:
For government pier at Tacloban, five thousand, five hundred dollars.
Total of appropriations for all purposes in Mexican money, thirteen thousand and seven dollars.
